title: Part Seven: The Pentagon and the Services

sections.brief: The command framework: 1981 MOU, 1983 JPMG/JSAP, 1987 MNNA, 1988 MOA, EUCOM to CENTCOM (2021), WRSA-I and its drawdowns (2006, 2014, 2023 to Ukraine), the radar at Har Keren/Site 512. Figures: time; flow.

Service by service: Army (radar, THAAD, Iron Dome batteries), Navy (Haifa, carriers, destroyer intercepts), Air Force (F-35I Adir and its Israeli modifications), Marines (MRIC/Tamir), and joint exercises (Juniper Cobra, Juniper Oak). Figures: compare; stats.

US forces in Israel's defence against Iran: April and October 2024, June 2025, and the 2026 war; interceptor expenditure, costs and casualties as of October 2026; stated rationale and what the US gets. Figures: time; stats.
